notes: Taiwan added — 7 new places: Pigs' Heaven sanctuary (New Taipei), Sun Clover Ecovillage (Hualien), Jian Song Eco-Village (Taitung), City Home B&B (Hualien), Ánanda Suruci (Tainan), Loving Hut Paradise Island B&B (Penghu). Taiwan has very few vegan farm sanctuaries — Pigs' Heaven is the only confirmed one. Vegan food scene is thriving though.
